⚙️ Engineering Mechanics

Stress in beams, vessels, disks, columns and yield criteria

  • Beam Bending — Maximum stress and deflection in a beam under a point load
  • Euler Buckling — Load at which a slender column stops being straight
  • Hollow Spinning Disk — Stress raised in a rotating disk by its own mass
  • Thick Wall Cylinder — Hoop, radial and axial stress through the wall of a pressurised cylinder
  • Thick Wall Pressurized Sphere — Hoop and radial stress through the wall of a pressurised sphere
  • Von Mises Stress — One equivalent stress from a full 3D stress state, and the margin left before yield
